body:
We used an offline VM running a copy of our Agie Classic Cut 2S machine control. The control plotted CAMCraft’s placed DXF racetrack and circular punches. The R10 racetrack retained its arc centres and reversed direction on alternate passes. The circular jobs retained concentric passes and a 1 mm separation measured along the nominal arc.

All controller runs were offline. No physical cut was made.

A refresh of this branch against `main` (`4dba7019d`) was tried and stopped. Nothing was pushed, and this branch is not changed.

**Why it stopped:** the conflicts are in the same logic, so a merge cannot decide them.

- This PR is stacked on #2974, which is open. `main` has since rewritten the same writer for #2984 (commit `ee0dafe23`): `crates/post/src/agie/jescript.rs` is deleted, the native setup files go through `crates/post/src/agie_setup.rs`, and `export_with_review` refuses a separation length that is not 1.0 mm.
- `crates/post/src/agie/mod.rs` (4 hunks) and `contour.rs` (5 hunks): the two sides rewrote the same functions (`prepare`, the export path).
- `assets/posts/agie-native.cps`, `separationLengthMm`: this PR says "Choose zero for a straight open cutoff"; `main` says "Zero leaves it unspecified and blocks export". The two rules contradict each other.
- `crates/app/src/operation/wire_sketch.rs`: each side added the full file.
- The goldens `arcs.refusal` and `full_circle.refusal` on `main` refuse arcs. The arc output of this PR must replace them; that is a decision of the author.

**What is necessary:** first #2974 takes `main` and the correction of #2984 (the body of this PR says the same). Then this branch takes #2974. We do not do that rewrite for you, because it changes how the native job is written. Tell us if you want help with a part of it.

Port to the current frame, head `124be7caf`.

- The branch merged `04cec49fe` (#2974). It now uses the #2984 zero-step setup writer and the #3180 selected-chain wire path. It merges cleanly with `main`.
- The operation selects one closed DXF chain. The whole-drawing source, its stamp, the prism mesh and the `jescript.rs` writer are gone. `docs/decisions/2022-agie-placed-dxf.md` has the reasons.
- The SBL is the control-checked `CCSEP20` punch setup. Only the stem and the threading hole change. No setup field is new.
- The emulated control imported RACE20, CIRCLE20, NORTH15 and EAST6. Each work had zero steps at import and `CCB030[4]` after TECCUT, and FORMALCHECK gave `geen fouten`. The plots kept the nominal centres and radii, and the separation was 1.000 mm.
- Quick gate: one known red step (#3774). Strict Clippy passed.

The PR body has the details.

Needs changes before merge. Four body requirements and one gate result need attention.

Reviewed locally against upstream main `c65757d0762b5004ccbb4121f8a24630ce3e5e63`. The trial merge is `599cd6d78739addfd605a0ecaaba6c95e8d1320b`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. The merge is clean. This is a safety-tier review of geometry and posted wire EDM output.

The earlier maintainer note about conflicts is addressed by the port in `124be7caf`. The shared zero-step setup writer is used. A closed contour still refuses zero separation. The review also covers the inherited punch-group and open-cutoff changes that remain above main.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:236`: Add before/after screenshots for the two new cutoff controls. The body has no screenshots. Store them only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to this PR branch.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`: Add `Process change: yes` to the body. This skill change is a process change under current upstream `AGENTS.md`. Do not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.
3. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/CIRCLE20.ISO:1`: Add a `Goldens moved` section to the body. List all five added golden files: `CIRCLE20.ISO`, `RACE20.ISO`, and `crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/{LOWER20.SBL,PAIR20.SBL,PAIR20.SBR}`. Explain each addition. The body currently calls LOWER20 and PAIR20 unchanged, but these files are additions relative to upstream main.
4. `crates/post/tests/agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1` and `crates/post/tests/agie_group_setup.rs:1`: Give the required one-line reason for each new top-level test binary. Alternatively, put the tests in an existing domain directory suite. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “New tests join a directory suite”, requires this reason in the body.

5. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/support.rs:311`: The full quick gate failed the two 3D rough/finish budget checks. Bare upstream main passed the standalone suite. The PR also passed standalone and failed-step retries, as recorded below. Under the requested all-green rule, these retries do not establish a green full quick run or the same failure on bare main. Provide a green quick run on this head, or show the same failure on bare main with an equivalent gate plan. No output error was found in these tests.

**Local build and test results**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 1,199 passed steps; 1 failed step; 0 stalled; 36.9 minutes |
| Strict Clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Geometry library | 72 passed |
| Post library | 134 passed |
| App `agie_native` | 25 passed |
| App `wire_dxf_selection` | 3 passed |
| UI library | 1,583 passed; 8 ignored; new cutoff Apply/undo test passed |
| All five light suite steps | 11 tests passed; 0 failed |

The initial red step was `app suites: example_catalog`: 37 passed, 2 failed, 4 ignored. Both failures reached the 60-second budget:

```text
3d/rough-finish rebuilds: did not finish within 60s
3d/rough-finish regenerates: did not finish within 60s
```

I ran the same standalone suite with two test threads on bare upstream main: 39 passed, 4 ignored. I restored the trial merge and repeated it: 39 passed, 4 ignored. I then repeated the failed gate step:

```text
CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=2 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --failed gate-logs/quick-20261124-071522
1 step, 0 failed, 0 stalled
```

The failure did not reproduce in these runs. The initial full parallel run remains recorded as red. I did not repeat the full parallel gate.

**Extra suites run**

The golden readers ran in the quick gate: `agie_native` (25 passed), `agie_cutoff_setup` (4), `agie_group_setup` (4), `agie_safe_setup` (8), and `script_agie_native` (11). The catalog suites ran by name: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed), and `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed).

All light targets ran in release: `motion light: lib` (7 passed), `adaptive_troch_island` (1), `adaptive_troch_neck` (1), `adaptive_troch_parallel` (1), and `app light: pocket_pass_start` (1). I omitted the broad build-only step and let each target build normally. No light test was omitted. Full heavy lanes were not run for this P4 PR.

**Independent input mutations**

I repeated three input mutations through the CLI in temporary directories. No source file was edited.

- Circle hole Y0 → Y0.001: expected refusal, no published directory. Restore Y0: success, ISO bytes match the golden.
- Unselected mark at X20.30: expected envelope refusal, no published directory. Move it to X20.50: success, ISO bytes match the golden.
- Move the drawing after generation: expected stale-input refusal, no published directory. Keep its generated placement: success, ISO bytes match the golden.

**Golden inspection**

I read all five added golden files line by line. CIRCLE20 has two concentric G03 semicircles. RACE20 retains cap centres (10, 1) and (-6, 1), with incremental I/J values. LOWER20 has separate air points at X-44 and X44, Y-3, and zero separation. PAIR20 maps each ISO and threading hole to its own work, with one shared quality and zero imported erosion steps. The existing CCSEP20 and DIE20 goldens are unchanged.

No physical cut or controller run was made for this review. The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This PR goes back to draft for the review fixes. The fix moves the new top-level test binaries into existing suites and runs a new quick gate on the final head. The PR is flagged ready again when the gate is green.
This PR has no linked issue. Please name the issue it closes, with `Fixes #N` or `Refs #N` in the body. The PR cannot carry the P label until then.

The body names the issue in its last line: `Refs #2022`. GitHub links a PR to an issue only through a closing keyword (`Fixes`, `Closes`), so the sidebar shows no link.

This PR does only part of #2022: the wire EDM post of one selected DXF circle or racetrack punch. #2022 also asks for laser work and for other drawings, so this PR must not close it. AGENTS.md says to use `Refs #N` for partial work.

If you want a closing link, tell me. I can then file a sub-issue of #2022 for the wire EDM part and change the last line to `Fixes #<sub-issue>`.

Reply to the review of `124be7caf` (comment 7125744183). New head: `7e490d7c2`.

1. **Screenshots** (`wire_page.rs:236`): the body has the before/after pair from the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, in "UI screenshots".
2. **`Process change: yes`** (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`): the body has the line. `PROCESS_VERSION` is not changed.
3. **Goldens moved** (`CIRCLE20.ISO:1`): the body lists the five added files with their reasons: `CIRCLE20.ISO`, `RACE20.ISO`, `LOWER20.SBL`, `PAIR20.SBL` and `PAIR20.SBR`.
4. **New top-level test binaries** (`agie_cutoff_setup.rs:1`, `agie_group_setup.rs:1`): both moved unchanged into the existing suite `agie_safe_setup`, as the modules `cutoff` and `group` (in #2972 and #2974; this PR merges them). The suite has 16 tests. The PR adds no new top-level test file now. The body has a "Test layout" section.
5. **A green full quick run** (`example_catalog/support.rs:311`): on `7e490d7c2`, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` ran the batch fallback: 1201 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (40.8 min). The 1-minute load average was under 25 at the start. `example_catalog` passed, with `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds` and `::regenerates`. The head merges `origin/main` `aedd9750c`, so the `rotary_verify` step of #3774 is green too.

Strict clippy (`-D warnings`, all targets): clean. The merge with main is clean.

Delta class (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2978 --reviewed 124be7caf`): NEW CODE. The new commits are two merges of the #2974 branch (`6718ef33`, `7e490d7c2`), which bring the test moves and the merge of main. This PR has no new commit of its own.

Ready for a re-check.

**Earlier findings**
